results.title: Australia’s newest senator sworn in
results.description: A former staffer for Tasmanian Premier Jeremy Rockliff has been sworn in as the Liberal’s newest senator as the conservative party deals with the departure of two long-time parliamentarians from the island state.

results.description: ISTANBUL, Aug 17 (Bernama-Anadolu) -- Eight countries on Sunday condemned Israel's rejection of a roadmap for completing the implementation of US President Donald Trump's plan to end the Gaza conflict, saying the move jeopardises efforts to achieve lasting peace, Anadolu Ajansi reported.

results.title: World : Zambian President Hichilema Heads Towards 2nd-term Victory
results.description: LUSAKA (Zambia), Aug 17 (Bernama-Anadolu) -- Zambian President Hakainde Hichilema took a commanding lead Sunday in the country’s presidential race, securing more than 1.5 million votes from 135 of the 226 constituencies counted, Anadolu Ajansi (AA) reported.

results.title: World : Trump Instructs Pentagon Chief To 'Substantially' Reduce S. Korea-USÂ military Drills
results.description: WASHINGTON, Aug 17 (Bernama-Yonhap) -- US President Donald Trump said Sunday that he has instructed the Pentagon chief to "substantially" reduce joint U.S.-South Korea military exercises, noting that those exercises are not only "costly" but also send a "totally inappropriate and hostile" signal to North Korea.
